title: LIYAH releases an infectious track titled "Lovely"
htmlContent:
LIYAH is a multi-talented singer and songwriter from Maryland. The emceeing figure takes her time to produce and write all her songs which keeps her fans coming back for more. This is on full display with the release of her recent track "Lovely."

LIYAH "Lovely" is a song that sounds like what being in love feels like. It's a feel-good, easy listen you want to play while cruising down the highway with your boo on a perfect summer day. The emceeing and storytelling are the stuff of legends, as they carry the track masterfully with her high-class authentic flows and lyrics that make her pen respectable.
